requirements.text: Bachelor s or Master s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
3 6 years of professional experience in software development, with a strong focus on frontend engineering.
Strong hands-on experience developing modern, responsive, and scalable web applications.
Proficiency in React with experience building reusable and maintainable UI components.
Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern frontend development practices.
Experience integrating REST APIs, backend services, and third-party systems into frontend applications.
Assist in designing and building a scalable design system with reusable components and consistent user experiences.
Clearly communicate technical concepts, requirements, and solutions to non-technical stakeholders, both verbally and in writing.
Define solutions for new and complex technical problems and take end-to-end ownership of assigned projects.
Propose, demonstrate, and implement improvements to the frontend tooling, development processes, and technology stack.
Experience working in fintech or building software solutions that connect multiple complex business processes is highly preferred; startup experience and a strong product mindset are a plus.
